meta.promptText: Which face wash should I buy for oily skin in India under ₹500?

response.text:
Finding an effective face wash for oily skin under ₹500 in India is quite easy, as several dermatologist-backed and science-forward brands offer great formulations in this price range. For oily and acne-prone skin, look for ingredients like **Salicylic Acid (BHA)**, **Glycolic Acid (AHA)**, **Niacinamide**, or **Green Tea**, which help control excess sebum and clear out pores without completely stripping your skin.[thedeconstruct.in](https://thedeconstruct.in/products/salicylic-acid-face-wash#:~:text=Dermatologist%20Recommended%20Formula%3A%20Clinically%20tested%20and%20approved,on%20damp%20skin%3B%20Step%202%3A%20Rinse%20thoroughly)

The best options available in India under ₹500 include:

---

### 1. Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA Face Cleanser

* **Price:** ~₹299[www.idiva.com](https://www.idiva.com/beauty/skincare/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin/18075158#:~:text=%E2%80%A2%20The%20formulation%20of%20Capryloyl%20Salicylic%20Acid,natural%20barrier%2C%20moisture%20and%20keeps%20it%20calm.)
* **Hero Ingredients:** 2% Salicylic Acid, LHA (Capryloyl Salicylic Acid), Zinc[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/skin/cleansers/face-wash/c/8379#:~:text=%28217.9K%29%20Simple.%20Refreshing%20Facial%20Wash%2C%20100%25%20Soap-Free,Type.%20%E2%82%B9749%E2%82%B965912%25%20Off.%20Enjoy%20Free%20Gift.%204.5.)
* **Why it’s great:** This is a cult favorite for very oily and acne-prone skin.[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/skin/cleansers/face-wash/c/8379#:~:text=%28217.9K%29%20Simple.%20Refreshing%20Facial%20Wash%2C%20100%25%20Soap-Free,Type.%20%E2%82%B9749%E2%82%B965912%25%20Off.%20Enjoy%20Free%20Gift.%204.5.) Salicylic acid and LHA penetrate deep into pores to dissolve trapped oil, reduce blackheads, and prevent active breakouts.[www.idiva.com](https://www.idiva.com/beauty/skincare/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin/18075158#:~:text=%E2%80%A2%20The%20formulation%20of%20Capryloyl%20Salicylic%20Acid,natural%20barrier%2C%20moisture%20and%20keeps%20it%20calm.) It is fragrance-free, non-drying, and regulates sebum effectively.[www.idiva.com](https://www.idiva.com/beauty/skincare/best-face-wash-for-oily-skin/18075158#:~:text=%E2%80%A2%20The%20formulation%20of%20Capryloyl%20Salicylic%20Acid,natural%20barrier%2C%20moisture%20and%20keeps%20it%20calm.)

### 2. Deconstruct Salicylic Acid & Niacinamide Oil Control Face Wash

* **Price:** ~₹299 (often on discount for around ₹260)[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/skin/cleansers/face-wash/c/8379#:~:text=All%20Skin%20Type.%20%E2%82%B9449%E2%82%B938215%25%20Off.%20Flash%20Sale,Price%20dropped%20by%20%E2%82%B938.%204.5.%20%28217.9K%29%20Simple.)
* **Hero Ingredients:** 2% Salicylic Acid, 1.5% Niacinamide[thedeconstruct.in](https://thedeconstruct.in/products/salicylic-acid-face-wash#:~:text=DECONSTRUCTING%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Oil%20Control%20Face%20Wash,pores%2C%20and%20reduce%20excess%20oil%20production.%20https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cir-safety.org%2Fsites%2Fdefault%2Ffiles%2Fsalicy042019FAR.pdf.)
* **Why it’s great:** Combining two heavy-hitter ingredients, this gel-based cleanser targets both excess oil and enlarged pores.[thedeconstruct.in](https://thedeconstruct.in/products/salicylic-acid-face-wash#:~:text=DECONSTRUCTING%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Oil%20Control%20Face%20Wash,pores%2C%20and%20reduce%20excess%20oil%20production.%20https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cir-safety.org%2Fsites%2Fdefault%2Ffiles%2Fsalicy042019FAR.pdf.) The salicylic acid deep-cleans sebum, while niacinamide works to calm redness, regulate long-term oil production, and repair the skin barrier.[thedeconstruct.in](https://thedeconstruct.in/products/salicylic-acid-face-wash#:~:text=HIghly%20Effective%20Yet%20Gentle%20Cleansing%3A%20Formulated%20with,cleanses%20to%20remove%20excess%20sebum%2C%20unclog%20pores.)

### 3. Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash

* **Price:** ~₹375 (frequently discounted lower)

* **Hero Ingredients:** Clay, PHA (Polyhydroxy Acid)[blog.flash.co](https://blog.flash.co/face-wash/top-25-face-washes-for-oily-skin/#:~:text=The%20Derma%20Co.%20Pore%20Minimizing%20Clay%20Daily,major%20platforms%20including%20Nykaa%2C%20Amazon%2C%20and%20Myntra.)
* **Why it’s great:** Clay helps absorb surface oil instantly, while PHA provides very gentle, daily chemical exfoliation.[blog.flash.co](https://blog.flash.co/face-wash/top-25-face-washes-for-oily-skin/#:~:text=The%20Derma%20Co.%20Pore%20Minimizing%20Clay%20Daily,major%20platforms%20including%20Nykaa%2C%20Amazon%2C%20and%20Myntra.) ### 5. Pilgrim Tea Tree Purifying Foaming Face Wash

* **Price:** ~₹175[blog.flash.co](https://blog.flash.co/face-wash/top-25-face-washes-for-oily-skin/#:~:text=Plum%20Green%20Tea%20Pore%20Cleansing%20Face%20Wash,the%20cheapest%20top-ranked%20products%20in%20the%20list.)
* **Hero Ingredients:** Tea Tree, Salicylic Acid[blog.flash.co](https://blog.flash.co/face-wash/top-25-face-washes-for-oily-skin/#:~:text=Pilgrim%20Tea%20Tree%20Purifying%20Foaming%20Face%20Wash,wash%20in%20the%20ranking.%2096%2F100.%20%E2%82%B9209.%20%E2%86%93)
